comment: Override any of these without committing in config/dashboard.local.json (git-ignored). Env wins over both: LAB_UI_PORT, LAB_UI_KEY. With `users` ([{name, key, roles:[requester|approver|operator]}]) sign-in is by account; remove `key` to allow accounts only.
embedAutoSignInComment: When an allowed origin frames the page, the person is signed in without the access key: the Dime app has already signed them in. Local development only; set false for a hosted desk until it has a token from the Dime API.
embedComment: Origins allowed to embed the page in an iframe (the Dime web app in local development). Empty = nobody.
